versions.changelog:
Initial release of CodeRules - AI-powered code style & quality assistant:

- Automatically detects project tech stack (TypeScript/Python/Go/Rust/Java) and relevant frameworks.
- Loads and applies language and framework-specific code rules for code generation and review.
- Supports: code generation with strict rule compliance, linting/auditing existing code, fixing non-compliant code, and initializing projects with recommended rules.
- Provides structured outputs: analysis result, rules applied, file list, generated code, and self-checklist.
- Supports user customization via .coderules.json.
- Includes universal standards for code quality, security, performance, and testing.
